title: athyrium hasseltii
intro: Athyrium hasseltii, commonly known as Hasselt's lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Athyrium genus. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antiseptic agent. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium hasseltii include its use in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
